verdict.rationale: BVNK's evidence shows a structured REST API, webhooks, Hawk auth, and an llms.txt for documentation discoverability, plus a mention of an 'agent-wallet-cli' repo, but nothing indicates the product can be operated via natural-language commands (no chat interface, NL parsing, or agent command layer described). The CLI mention is unelaborated and appears to be a structured command tool, not NL-driven.
